---
title: "check-definition-equations.yml"
---

Diff-scoped, warn-only heuristic check for the lab's rule
(Ezra, 2026-10-29)
that a definition div holds only the equation
linking the symbol of the defined term to its definitional expression.
An equality between expressions, or an equivalence between concepts,
is stated as a result (`#thm-`, `#lem-`, `#cor-` or `#prp-`)
after the definition.

The check flags a `#def-` div when

- a display equation chains equalities:
  it has a defining operator
  (`:=`, `\eqdef`, `\coloneqq`, `\triangleq`)
  followed by another top-level `=`,
  or, with no defining operator, two or more top-level `=`;
- the div displays more than one equation,
  unless each carries its own defining operator; or
- the prose says the defined concept is equivalent to something else
  ("equivalently", "in other words", "is equivalent to", "is the same as",
  "also written", "which equals").

An `=` inside brackets or `\text{}`, and a `cases` display, do not count.
The check cannot tell which side of a single `a = b` is the defined symbol,
so a definition displaying one equation between two expressions is not flagged.
A definition that holds `<!-- def-equiv-ok: reason -->` is exempt.

A definition is checked when the pull request adds a line inside it.
With no base to diff against, the check skips instead of scanning the whole tree,
so existing definitions are fixed when someone edits them anyway.
It warns by default; `fail: true` blocks.

## Inputs

| Input | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `globs` | `*.qmd` | Git pathspecs of tracked files to check (recursive) |
| `paths-ignore` | none | Comma or newline separated globs to skip |
| `fail` | `false` | Fail on a finding; `false` warns |
| `whole-tree` | `false` | Check every definition, to measure a corpus |
| `python-version` | `3.x` | Python version |
| `runs-on` | empty (`CI_RUNNER` variable, else `ubuntu-latest`) | Runner label; a self-hosted label only for a private repository |

## Usage

Copy `examples/check-definition-equations.yml` to
`.github/workflows/check-definition-equations.yml`.
